t: A visual block coding app for making games and animations on iPad.
steps: Install the app from the App Store on an iPad.
Sign up as an educator on the Hopscotch site.
Create a class and student accounts.
Confirm current prices with the vendor.
Open the Educators page and pick an introductory lesson plan.
Review which projects students may publish.
Note that account changes for students go through a separate classrooms email address.
